correctness.rationale: The necessary sigma*(n)>=2n makes the five smallest primes 3,5,7 obligatory, and gives s<=32(r+1)/(3r-32) with r in {11,13,17,19}. The resulting squarefree supports number 87. Exact monotone abundancy bounds exclude exponent repetition except s^2 for r=11 and s=13,17,19. Independent full certificate check from witnesses.json confirmed all 90 distinct candidates and each exact proper-unitary-divisor subset sums to sigma*/2-n. Independently rederived all 90 cases and used integer bitset subset sums, obtaining 90 successes and least n=15015. Four-or-fewer-prime odd numbers have sigma*/n<=768/385<2.

evidence: Das Prop 2.4 imposes sigma*>=2n; published even support-three case concerns opposite parity.
